description: Fetch a previously generated invoice by its `invoice_id` and return its current metadata plus its download URL. Read-only. For Scribo invoices the `invoice_id` is the access credential: anyone who holds it can read the metadata and download the file, so treat it as a secret. The download URL is not signed, and `download_url_expires_at` is informational today. Unknown IDs, and invoices created inside the Causa Prima app, return 404. Use this after `create_invoice` to re-download bytes from a different device.
name: get_invoice
title: Fetch Invoice
